$comment: ⭐⭐ THIS SURFACE'S OWN CHROME COPY — Story 11b.17, the member's view of ONE drive. ⛔ The three STAGE words, the ZERO-DAY line, the लक्ष्य line and the Panel's five-paragraph MESSAGE BLOCK are ⛔ NOT here: they live in the ONE shared source, `sahyog-shared` (`2026-09-04-193` cl.3), and this surface CONSUMES them BY NAME. ⛔ Do ⛔ NOT mint a second copy of any of them here — two sources is exactly how 'Active' came to mean two different things. ⭐ The nominee's holder LABEL is ⛔ NOT here either: it is `sahyog-vivran`'s `label.account_holder`, whose VALUE is the Trustee-ratified 'Nominee Name' (`2026-09-04-190` cl.2). ⛔⛔ ⛔ NOT `member-drive-list`'s `nominee.label`, which renders 'Nominee', and ⛔ NOT `contribution`'s `upi_intent.account_holder_label`, which is literally 'Account holder' — the string cl.2 forbids.

$comment.bank: ⭐⭐ THE SECTION THIS WHOLE STORY EXISTS FOR — `2026-09-04-190` cl.3 as scoped by `-199`: a logged-in member of the drive's own Pariwar sees the COMPLETE banking information. ⛔⛔ THE VALUES ARE UNMASKED AND THAT IS THE POINT, ⛔ not an oversight — 'a masked account# cannot be transferred to'. ⛔ Do ⛔ not 'improve' this with a masked display. ⚠ The safety question is WHO SEES IT, ⛔ never how much of it. ⛔⛔ BOTH ACCOUNTS RENDER, EQUALLY (`2026-09-10-213` cl.1) — `rank` is row IDENTITY, ⛔ never a priority, ⛔ never primary/secondary. ⛔ No copy here may present one as preferred. ⚠⛔ AND TWO DIFFERING HOLDER NAMES ARE A LEGITIMATE STATE (`#decision-2026-09-13-215` — the schema carries ⛔ no FK, ⛔ no nominee_rank, ⛔ no match rule) ⇒ SURFACE BOTH, PICK NEITHER. ⛔ No copy may assert that either name IS the nominee: the column is `account_holder_name_ciphertext` and the SCHEMA is the authority. ⛔⛔ AND THERE IS ⛔ NO UPI-ID LABEL HERE, ON ⛔ ANY DRIVE, IN ⛔ ANY STAGE — `2026-09-10-212` cl.2 ruled the UPI ID onto the PAYMENT screen (story `8-17`, `done`, `upi_intent.vpa_label`).
